events.text: Found themselves in a magical testing facility.
Defeated demonic-dinosaurs and an enchanted divine chain trap.
Found an open door to the north.
Found a closed door to the south.
Stood in a sun deprived courtyard with west double doors.
Lorn opened the door.
Lorn, Daichi Kenshin, Cliff Chewstick, Padraig Dream-Soup, Gringles Snotbelly and Eda stood by the side.
GM described a room with meat-covered low tables and a northern double door.
Party chose to proceed onward through the northern doors.
Group opened the door and found the primary supply room.
Group saw bedrolls, ropes, cooking pots and other expedition supplies.
Padraig Dream-Soup noticed something strange about the equipment pile.
Daichi cast detect magic before opening.
Lorn gained a green slime-flesh arm on his skeletal arm.
Daichi went to the west door to open it carefully.
GM described a multi-purpose room with runed wall, holy symbols and mirrors.
Group saw purple-skinned mossy ghoul-like corpses hanging from ceiling beams.
Lorn shot the hanging corpses.
Daichi walked up to decipher the runes on the wall.
GM described notes pointing to a scratched-over dissolving symbol.
Tarsus entered the ancient city with the others and called out to a departing dwarf.
Pádraig sniffed brown-grey powder from a spoon and offered alchemy help.
Tarsus asked for a spare healing elixir and directions to the team's point of interest.
Tiny skulked up and demanded an elixir too.
Pádraig left Tarsus and Tiny standing in the entrance ramp and went to the carriage.
Tiny grabbed the elixir and ran down the path.
Fierce Leopard adjusted his pack and shield and moved to follow Tiny.
Tarsus thanked the dwarf and followed the others toward the other adventurers' structure.
The pair caught up to the group.
The party found themselves surrounded by ghouls hanging by nooses from concrete beams.
Tiny poked a ghoul with his spear and asked what the ghouls had done.
Tarsus investigated the runes on the bodies and walls with detect magic.
Allisee rolled 1d20+11.
Fierce Leopard searched the rest of the room for hidden secrets.
Tarsus identified two languages including Sin-speak intermingled with magic.
Tarsus described lab notes about bio-hacking with ooze form.
Fierce Leopard found a possible secret room or passage.
The party found a lock mechanism with an anvil symbol.
The party attempted to open the lock and used guidance and a hero point.
Tarsus diagrammed the room and the party decided to move on.
The party made their way back to the lobby.
The party found unlocked double doors to the south.
Tiny pushed the doors open.
Flies swarmed out of the room and bit the party.
The party saw a blood-stained rectangular room with benches, gore-filled tubs and corpses.
A blood-soaked fiend stood with two cultists giving a prayer and tutorial.
The fiend raised his cleaver and combat began.
The party rolled initiative with a highest result of 32.
Daichi cast Time Sense, entered arcane cascade and tripped the fiend.
Lorn dealt 46 piercing damage to the demonic creature.
Lorn's arrows destroyed the fiend.
Eda sprinted around the corner and joined the party in the room.
The second cultist was slain.
Eda killed the fleeing cultist with an eldritch shot.
Tarsus cast gale blast and shut the door after everyone moved into the next room.
Ademe sat on the massive bed and invited the party in.
Tarsus said they were after the statue taken from Kibwe.
Tiny listened at the western door.
Lorn saw a ghostly transparent Selenor standing next to him.
Tarsus recalled knowledge on the seven pointed star and examined the contract.
Lorn stood up and told the group to remember what he said.
A circle of power opened beneath Lorn and a being stepped forth from the wall.
Lorn was claimed as Sin-Lorn, weapon of the dead god.
Sin-Lorn's skeleton turned to multicoloured crystal with flesh and shackles.
Edeme told Sin-Lorn to go with his group and free the curse breaker.
Tarsus inspected Lorn's changed form with read aura and an Arcana check.
Tarsus commented on defaced gnoll bones and asked about deactivating security measures beyond the door.
Ademe explained the laboratory layout and the original purposes of the rooms.
Daichi searched the wall by hand for the hidden panel.
The party found a well hidden detection panel that would have exploded if the door was opened.
Daichi tried to disable the wiring using infiltrator tools.
The detection panel remained untriggered after a very close attempt.
Lorn moved toward the panel and tried to disable it.
The panel was disabled and the forward door appeared safe.
Fierce Leopard carried Lorn back away from the door.
Fierce Leopard checked the panel and found no traps.
Fierce Leopard raised his shield and touched the panel to open the door.
The party found an arcane machine at the end of the room.
Tarsus opened the hatch on the device.
The ooze flushed down a central ventilation shaft.
Leilani Kana entered and said she was sent to recover curse breaker.
The party searched the room and found nothing additional.
The party agreed to go down D stairs.
Group traveled downwards.
Walls showed old steam valves, many rusted and broken.
Steam blasts singed hairs and burned flesh lightly.
Group reached the bottom of the stairs.
Group found a long one way corridor.
Corridor showed more valves and gauges.
Leopard scouted down the corridor with shield raised.
Group started up the stairs quietly.
Leopard checked the door for traps and opening method.
Leilani pressed the button panel.
Group entered THE FORGE.
Combat started against the gorilla cultist and demonic dinosaur.
Ape cultist died.
Demon-dinosaur died.
Tiny searched all the crevices.
Tarsus refocused and checked for other exits.
Tarsus examined the unfinished chain armor.
Tarsus failed his forging attempt.
Tarsus and Daichi completed the moonlit chain armour.
Daichi opened the sliding double doors.
Party found a half-finished metal-plate book on a table.
Party saw four cultists repairing weapons and equipment.
Combat began as the cultists grabbed weapons.
Leilani killed one cultist.
Party killed the last cultist and ended combat.
Daichi healed Tiny and started searching the room.
GM described the sweatshop as a long strangely designed room.
GM described three doors to the west, south and east.
The party found a chest with a spyglass, runestones and blood-soaked bags.
The party resisted the temptation.
Tiny took the talking book and shoved it into his waistband.
Poking the blood-soaked bags caused metal clinking and flesh popping sounds.
Found various keys inside the meatballs.
Collected a keyring of many keys.
Learned the western door was locked with a matching key.
Learned the eastern doors were sealed by magic and mechanical forces.
Learned the southern door locks matched the keyring.
Decided to go where the keys would take them.
Found the secret passage to the Warehouse room from the Forge.
Unlocked and explored the western door.
Found a square room with Angazhan, Azlanti and Pharasma artwork and a covered painting.
Opened a west door leading to tunnels into other buildings.
Found a lever hidden behind several paintings.
Pulled the lever and theorized a second lever by the southern door.
Entered the prison with dozens of chained prisoners.
Found a torture altar with bags of dried leaves in the center.
Found the southern door carved with demon runes.
Met prisoners Dhira Graycheeks and Tavik.
Sacrificed the old man and unlocked the runed door with his blood.
Watched the freed prisoners flee leaving only the orc and rat woman.
Found plaques for the Hand Gallery and the private shrine.
Heard Eda Curse Breaker speak from behind the vault door.
Saw hundreds of six-fingered hands with plaques.
Learned the paws belonged to Gorilla Kings serving Angazhan.
Deciphered the arcane lock and unlocked the paws.
Found a storage box with magical gorilla gloves and six fingers elixir.
Stepped into the black metal private shrine.
Felt alignment sickness threatening to turn them chaotic evil.
Met the tired whipped gorilla cultist Ngira cleaning the floor.
Saw Sanura appear in a flash of red light.
Unlocked both doors including the courtyard door via the shrine runes.
Noticed a divine gemstone worth 140 GP.
Entered the Sacrificial Plaza of Forgotten Gods.
Saw twelve obsidian broken pillars weeping amber fluid.
Identified the western doors as Sweat Shop and Hand Gallery entries.
Found the old man with a demon raptor and two gorilla cultists.
Heard the old man introduce himself as Nyamat Mshwe called Theron.
Saw Theron had six fingers and wore the Angazhan symbol.
Leopard angrily confronted Theron about the threat, pain, suffering and murder.
Theron claimed his god approved his quest and asked about Ademe's planned experiment.
Theron claimed he saved people from death or monstrous transformation.
Theron called Paga Nikohian a halfling supremacist and said he accepted all races.
Eda told Lorn a complex rune was written on the vault and needed magic to read.
Theron smirked and allowed Lorn to leave unimpeded.
Lorn attempted a religion check on the seal.
Lorn asked Eda if she could read the seal.
Lorn left the shrine and asked Daichi if he could read the seal.
Lorn suggested the seal was powered by an outside source linked to Theron.
The group reunited in the courtyard where Theron waited by the pond with companions.
Lorn fired an arrow meant for one of Theron's women.
Theron struck Daichi for 26 points of damage.
A female cultist critically hit Tarsus Longstaff for 20 damage.
Lorn struck the raptor demon twice for 32 damage in total.
Eimer cast courageous anthem and fireball.
The party opened combat with a flame orb that exploded on the enemy.
Tarsus was blasted beside the pool of dark water by demonic magic.
Tiny went down to Dying 1 after cultist strikes.
Fierce Leopard felled the demon raptor and a female cultist.
Iwao sheathed his sword and ran off into a tunnel.
Theron offered his complete and full surrender.
Lorn contacted Aderme regarding Theron's fate and Ademe arrived.
Ademe thanked for the tablets and said she would take them and whatever else she wished.
Ademe put a dagger to Theron's throat in a rage.
Farai arrived saying Kibwe sent her to aid in acquiring the statue of curse breaking.
Farai exploded and turned into a slime monster.
Kieran swung his blade at the slime and the slime ruptured a spleen for 26 points of damage.
Kieran struck the slime with radiant sword strikes.
The slime split into two smaller slimes.
Lorn killed one slime.
Eda blasted the last slime dead and combat ended.
Kieran drank from the demon pool.
Leilani went south towards the door of the vault.
Kieran fell through a dark void.
Kieran saw a slimy black stand holding a flesh book covered in watching eyes.
Kieran learned he could command the book to show knowledge without unsealing it.
Theron proclaimed the green flame had saved the world.
Akwa and Welsa drank from the pool.
The book showed Kieran a future with dead children and Serena.
Kieran recited the ritual words from the book.
Pidge stepped out of the activated gateway.
Kieran rose reborn as a Divine Slime and the waters turned green.
Akwa became a much lesser divine-slime and her eidolon changed.
Juiblex revealed himself as the God of Slimes and awakened.
Kieran and Akwa returned to the material plane and Eda collapsed.
Eda said something used over 100% of Curse Breaker power to break a beyond mythical curse.
Theron swallowed some of Kieran slime.
Kieran kicked Theron in the gut.
The door was found unlocked.
Kieran and Akwa pushed open the vault.
The vault door opened and revealed two demon guardians and the restrained Curse Breaker.
The demons threw spears and Akwa was critically hit and left dying.
Leopard charged into the room and struck a demon with his shield.
Lorn's attack killed the final demon guardian.
Eda touched the statue and collapsed to the ground.
Tarsus explained Curse Breaker had burned its soul and Eda could revive it with her life force.
A black-furred fox left a sealed letter and scurried away
The party read Aberith's letter offering assistance
Kieran asked about a red-leaved tree in Spring
Tarsus warned they had less than two days to act
The fox waited by a previously unnoticed passageway
Tarsus followed the fox down the passageway
Tarsus found a Japanese maple tree and a stone obelisk
A voice spoke inside Tarsus's head
Tarsus explained the dilemma about rejuvenating Curse Breaker
The voice offered help in exchange for service
Tarsus realized the letter ritual was a communication spell
Kieran pressed his forehead against the Curse Breaker statue
A much smaller Eda was vomited out
Tarsus began the ritual
Curse Breaker was reborn and Eda's body burned to ash
The group leveled up to level 7
Eda walked through the wall leaving an Eda-shaped gap
Eda opened a portal to Kibwe in the courtyard
Eda stepped through the portal
Eda stood before a female red slime woman on the other side
Leopard made his way through the portal
Tarsus entered the portal
Kieran hopped through the portal
Akwa followed inside
Everyone had gone through the portal
The portal closed behind the party
Tal'lysae introduced herself and said she travelled to speak to them
Tal'lysae said she wished to help with their cause
Eda said her connection to Kibwe was severed and she must use the temple of the sun to reconnect
Kieran asked what the terms of the alliance were
Kieran asked what was expected of the city and of them.
Tal'lysae said defending the city was acceptable but they were capable of more.
Lorn said they could become more than their assigned roles by trusting one another.
Kieran nodded and agreed to do this.
Tal'lysae felt a disturbance in the air and earth.
Leilani asked Tal'lysae to speak plainly about what was felt.
Leopard hefted his shield and urged the party to move.
Tiny said he was not hired for this and wandered off.
Tal'lysae said dark forces clouded Tiny's soul.
Kieran led the party into the city with his glowing bow.
Saw the guard towers of Kibwe stood unguarded.
Saw large slimes filled the guard towers.
Heard Tal'lysae say they would avoid the threats.
Followed Tal'lysae around the walls past destroyed hamlets.
Climbed down the steel ladder into the service tunnel.
Saw slime drips formed tiny crawling organisms.
Arrived at a large stone door locked by a magical rune.
Watched Eda turn the stone door to ash and leap away.
Walked into the light of the city of Kibwe.
Saw the merchant streets stood nearly empty.
Saw corpses of non-humans littered the way.
Heard Tal'lysae point to the golden dome Sun Temple.
Heard Tal'lysae guess Paga Nikohian was in the Sun Temple.
Watched the merchant collapse into sewage-brown slime.
Saw the triceratops round on the group.
Saw the dwarf explode and the slime evolve.
Watched the triceratops calm and wait.
Saw the White Flame Slime surge toward the group.
Watched Master Cho dust his blade and strike the slime.
Tarsus rushed up and spellstruck the slime with lightning.
Tarsus collapsed the slime's dimensional rift to counter its teleport.
Daichi struck the slime hard as it tried to teleport.
The slime grabbed Daichi and Kieran and dealt force damage.
Fierce Leopard stepped into the slime's portal and vanished.
Slime monster parts worth 300 Gold Pieces lay scattered.
Fierce Leopard arrived far from Kibwe and vomited blood.
Leopard found himself on a platform in an endless void.
Leopard saw hundreds of thousands of huge starships in the clouds.
The dwarf warned that something was coming for them all.
Bashevis warned time was short as the rift shrank to a crack.
Bashevis moved to press his hands into the rift and asked if ready.
Bashevis poured flame magic into the rift.
Bashevis form was poured into the rift.
The platform shattered.
Ryo was violently lurched through time and space.
Party stood on the sandy ground of Kibwe streets.
Fierce Leopard returned in a burst of white light covered in slime.
Fierce Leopard and Daichi Kenshin were at full health.
Party started walking towards the temple of the sun.
Kieran tried to shoo the triceratops away and it stayed.
The slime layer sank into the triceratops and glowed green.
Party approached a tall wooden watchtower.
A circle of mages was seen casting a ritual on the roof.
A green orb manifested while purple lightning popped it.
Tavik reported the curse was evolving.
A massive crack split the air and the green orb flickered.
Tarsus ran up the stairs to help with the ritual.
Ji Yun's flamethrower destroyed Slime #07.
Awnii appeared at the top of the watchtower.
Tal'lysae declared the ritual complete.
Fierce Leopard killed the last standing slime.
Tal'lysae went downstairs to give medical attention.
Lorn went downstairs and found the dead and survivors.
Orb shrank and looked like a seed
Slime tree grew in centre of tower roof
Flower sprouted at base of tree
Kieran saw translucent woman on roots then she vanished
Tal'lysae lay on ground glitching out
Tarsus hurried out of tower to street
Moffat said he must leave for backup shelter
Moffat left with Nexians, mercenaries and citizens
Kieran made his way out of tower to group
Petals appeared in hands of group members
Tal'lysae loaded slimes onto party mule
Tal'lysae described bridge between flames and slime-kind
Party came close to Sun temple
Guards with scythes guarded entrance
Ademe identified guards as dark fey mercenaries
Tal'lysae said grey flame was Wandering Chronicler
Lorn equipped composite longbow
Group ducked into alleyway and rested
Lorn fired two arrows at Dark Fey guard and flesh healed
Tal'lysae blew head off Dark Fey Guard 1 and it regenerated
Leopard raised shield and waited
Tarsus recognised guards as Red Caps
Tarsus learned hat loss removed regeneration
Kieran scored two natural 20s against the Dark Fey Guards.
Tal'Lysae critically hit and killed Dark Fey Guard 1.
Kieran killed Dark Fey Guard 3 and all guards lay dead.
Tal'Lysae said the Sun Temple lay before the party.
The party stood ready outside the sealed stone doors.
Anna slid down her spear and asked what was going on.
The party shoved open the doors of the Temple of the Sun.
Tarsus saw room 1 of the Sun Temple open into the entryway.
Daichi recalled the western door led to a sleeping room.
Daichi recalled the eastern door led to the Chamber of Welcome.
Masters in perception heard growing in the Chamber of Sleep.
Daichi saw a flash of red fur and golden chains.
A cat-like Golden Guardian leapt at Daichi and combat began.
The Golden Guardian died and the party saved Daichi.
The party found beds and a scratched Eda statue.
Tarsus repaired Daichi's armour with scrap metal.
Cho heard Halfling and Dwarvish through the thick doors.
The party finished healing and faced the Welcome doors.
The party swung open the doors to the Chamber of Welcome.
Around 48 armed guards stood before the party.
The guards unleashed a prepared round of crossbow bolts.
Combat against the small guards began in the Chamber of Welcome.
The guards spread out in groups sharing HP and actions.
Lorn and Tal'Lysae won initiative with 34.
The Northern Doors swung open and two gnomes confronted the party.
Tal'Lysae shot and destroyed the first guard legion.
Fierce Leopard struck and destroyed the second guard legion.
Ji Yun burned and killed the remains of the fourth legion.
Narrow and Wide threw bombs and ran north to retreat.
The gnomes continued running while the party strode after them.
Wide took 89 damage from Fierce Leopard.
Narrow stowed bomb and rapier and surrendered.
Combat ended on the first floor of the Sun Temple.
Tal'Lysae gathered 320 GP worth of body parts from dead guards.
Tarsus became master of the dual-mode Rod of Wonder.
Party decided to head toward the trapped staircase.

time_cues: anywhere from hours to a day at most

events.text: Party stood before the doors to the scribing chamber.
No magic was found on the door except sigils.
The door did not seem trapped.
Tal'Lysae asked about forging a creation from slain foes.
Daichi opened the door of the chamber of scribing.
The party entered the scribing chamber covered in maps and stone slabs.
The slabs emitted lightning bolts and combat began.
Master Cho Kobo stayed out of combat to guard the gnomes.
Eda Stone-Worth's voice said a new temple Guardian was needed.
The lightning sigils glowed and struck five allies.
